extracted.intended_audience: PR professionals, communications and marketing teams, and anyone writing press releases
extracted.subtask_description: Guidance for crafting, formatting, and distributing press releases to maximize journalist engagement and reach target audiences. Emphasizes headline choice, newsline selection, content that appeals to journalists, and formatting for success.

rubrics_metrics.name: Design press release to maximize engagement with your target audience
rubrics_metrics.description: The press release is the culmination of months or years of hard work and should be designed to maximize engagement with your target audience.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Focus the release on audience engagement—tailor messaging, angle, and distribution to the people and outlets you want to reach so the work of creating the release yields measurable attention.

rubrics_metrics.name: Format your press release for optimal success
rubrics_metrics.description: If you’ve ever wondered how to format your press release for optimal success, we have put all of our data-backed recommendations into a comprehensive guide.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use proven formatting best practices (structure, length, use of boilerplate/contact info, links, multimedia) because presentation affects pick-up and readability.

rubrics_metrics.name: Craft a headline best suited to your press release content
rubrics_metrics.description: How to craft a headline that is best suited to your press release content
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Create a clear, concise, and newsworthy headline directly tied to the release’s central message so journalists and readers immediately understand the news value.

rubrics_metrics.name: Include elements that appeal to journalists
rubrics_metrics.description: What to include in your press release that appeals to journalists
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provide the facts, quotes, data, and assets journalists need to cover the story quickly (clear lede, supporting details, contact information, multimedia), reducing friction for coverage.

rubrics_metrics.name: Choose the right newsline to receive engagement
rubrics_metrics.description: Why choosing the right newsline is critical to receiving engagement
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Select an appropriate newsline/category or distribution channel that matches the topic and target outlets to increase relevance and pickup.

rubrics_metrics.name: Ensure your press release isn’t overlooked by those who matter most
rubrics_metrics.description: Ensure your press release isn’t overlooked by those who matter most and download our guide today.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Prioritize targeting, timing, and clarity so the people and publications you care about notice and act on the release.
